ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ كَانَ مِنْ خُلُقِهِ الْبَشَاشُ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī kāna min khuluqihi ‘l-bashāsh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who was of cheerful disposition!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ تَبَرَّأَ مِنَ الْغَاشِّ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī tabarra’a min l-ghāsh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who was free of deception!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ ارْزُقْنَا بِبَرَكَتِهِ طَيِّبَ الْمَعَاشِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘rzuqnā bi barakatihī ṭayyiba ‘l-ma`āsh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and provide by his blessing a pleasant life!
